In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PST mRNA is expressed in all areas where PSA-NCAM is expressed.
PSA-NCAM is developmentally regulated in a spatial-temporal pattern and that PST is involved in the regulation of PSA-NCAm levels.
the developmental and adult expression of PSA- NCAM in the brain may depend on a complex interaction between PSA-NCAM and its ligand(s) and/or other molecules such as PST.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PST is an enzyme that may be involved in the developmental regulation and maintenance of the PSA- NCAM levels in the brain.
PSA-NCAM expression in the adult rat hippocampus is regulated by PST.
PST mRNA is present in the embryonic brain and is developmentally regulated.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the temporal and spatial expression profile of PST mRNA in the developing brain is different from that of the adult rat brain.
the expression of PST mRNA in the developing brain is not restricted to areas where PSA-NCAM is expressed, and that PST expression is not restricted to the embryonic period.
PST mRNA expression in the rat brain is developmentally and spatially regulated, suggesting a role of this enzyme in the regulation of PSA-NC AM levels.
